title: Clinical Language Evaluation With AI for Residents
official: Clinical Language Evaluation With AI for Residents (CLEAR2) - A Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: The purpose of this study is to refine and test existing enterprise-grade large language model (LLM) based on generative artificial intelligence (AI), to assess the feasibility and acceptability of LLM-based feedback, to assess the ability of LLM-based feedback to improve residents' communications,to explore the ability of standardized patients to assess residents' communication and to explore the ability of residents to self-assess their communication complexity
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* McGovern Medical School (MMS) general surgery residents
* postgraduate year (PGY) 1-5
